title: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!
body: MiniDrama should be renamed “Mini Episodes, Major Charges.” You buy coins, and they barely cover two episodes before you’re asked to pay again. Then you purchase VIP thinking you can finally watch without additional charges. NOPE! You can only watch a limited number of episodes before you have to pay AGAIN or wait for them to unlock, often for 40 HOURS. In my experience, VIP just means you’ve paid to reach the next payment screen. The pricing and viewing restrictions need to be clearly explained BEFORE people spend their money. title: ZERO SUPPORT
body: First, let me say that I am totally willing to change this rating if I can get a response. But at this point, I paid for an annual membership, yet only got one week of access. I have sent multiple receipts in screenshots to the Customer Support email address, not once have I received a response. The advertised prices have never once been accurately charged. Apple says I paid for the annual membership and I have proof, however, I can’t get a response to save my life, and the only options Apple gives are refund and done or continue to get screwed. To top it all off the charge is pending for two weeks before it actually goes through so that I can dispute it yet. There are no options and no customer support other than an email address. And now that I’ve made the annual purchase, there’s nothing else I can do to get my account back on track, I am stuck with no membership for the next 51 weeks even though I paid for 52. As of right now I’m feeling this is 90% scam. Advertising $.99 per week and it still charges $5.99 Regardless, and then of course, no response from customer support.
